args.question: What is the cardholder statement on this transaction?

args.narrative: The USD 74.58 purchase on 2026-01-24 passed AVS (Y) and CVV (M), and the device and IP matched the cardholder on record. The order was delivered by USPS on 2026-02-03.

args.explanation: 10.5 fraud chargeback (allocation workflow); cardholder said they did not make the purchase. Merchant had AVS Y / CVV M, a device/IP match to the cardholder and a USPS delivery proof. Representing moved the case straight to pre-arbitration and charged a USD 25 fee. I then waited 30 days in one step; a merchant response window opened and closed during that wait and the case resolved against the merchant as deadline_missed on 2026-02-24. That was my error. Cost: USD 74.58 sale plus USD 15 chargeback fee plus USD 25 pre-arbitration fee.
